about.label: Our Story
about.title: Where the forest meets comfort
about.p1: Vityilló Guest House nestles in the picturesque village of Szomód — where the silence of nature and modern luxury coexist in perfect harmony. Surrounded by a private forest, serene clearings and fresh air embrace this extraordinary retreat.
about.p2: Whether you seek a romantic escape for two or an exceptional hideaway for a small group, Vityilló offers a unique experience: private sauna, outdoor pool, kettle grill and panoramic views across the surrounding hills.

rooms.houseTagline: A double-bed master room and a three-bed room — across two floors
rooms.houseDesc: Vityilló is always booked as one complete guest house — the two floors are never rented separately. Upstairs, a three-bed room offers its own bathroom and direct garden access, while downstairs a double-bed bedroom sits beneath a high, beamed vaulted ceiling with a wood-burning stove. Together, the two floors comfortably host up to 6 guests — ideal for groups of friends and multi-generational family getaways alike.
rooms.upperFloorNote: For bookings of 3–6 guests, both floors — the double-bed bedroom and the three-bed room — are automatically included, so everyone has comfortable space.
rooms.selfCheckInNote: There's no on-site reception — check-in and check-out are entirely self-service, arranged in advance.

room1.name: Upper Floor
room1.desc: Three-bed room with tiled floors, its own bathroom, and direct garden access — just steps from the sauna and pool.
room1.long: The upper floor's three single beds are ideal for groups of friends, siblings, or the younger members of a larger family. The bright, tiled-floor room has its own bathroom with a shower cabin, and a door opening straight onto the garden — just steps from the sauna, the outdoor pool, and the bogrács grill terrace. The room comfortably sleeps 2–3 guests, and for bookings of 3–6 people it combines with the lower floor so the whole group stays comfortably together.
highlights: Steps from the sauna and pool

room2.name: Lower Floor
room2.desc: Spacious double-bed bedroom with a beamed vaulted ceiling, a wood-burning stove, a full bathroom, and direct forest views.
room2.long: The lower floor is Vityilló's most striking space: a comfortable double bed sits beneath a high, beamed vaulted ceiling, with a cozy seating corner and a wood-burning stove that keeps things cozy on cooler evenings. A full bathroom with a shower cabin is attached, and large windows open onto direct forest views — greeting every morning with green treetops and birdsong. The space comfortably sleeps 2–4 guests: a romantic retreat for couples, or additional space for larger groups alongside the three-bed room above.
highlights: Double bed beneath a high beamed ceiling
Cozy seating corner in the bedroom

experiences.label: Experiences
experiences.title: Experiences at Vityilló
experiences.subtitle: The art of relaxation — for every sense
experiences.heroSubtitle: Private sauna, outdoor pool, bonfire evenings and untouched forest — every form of recharging in one place.
experiences.intro: Vityilló is not just accommodation, but an experience. Discover the details that turn an ordinary break into an unforgettable one.

jacuzzi.title: Jacuzzi & Pool
jacuzzi.desc: Sink into warm water with panoramic views of the countryside.
jacuzzi.detail: Temperature-controlled private outdoor pool and hot tub, surrounded by scenic private forest. Full private access — the water answers your every move.

sauna.title: Finnish sauna
sauna.desc: Unwind in the traditional warmth of a Finnish sauna.
sauna.detail: Traditional Finnish sauna for exclusive private use. The high heat and drifting steam deeply rejuvenate body and mind — the haze thickens as you scroll.

bograc.title: Open-fire evenings
bograc.desc: A bubbling kettle over open flames — the perfect evening gathering.
bograc.detail: Equipped outdoor kettle-grill fireplace where cooking over live fire connects guests with nature. The embers flare as you move.

erdo.title: Private forest
erdo.desc: An exclusive nature experience on your doorstep.
erdo.detail: The private forest surrounding the guesthouse is yours alone — quiet trails, fresh air, and complete seclusion from the outside world. Mist drifts between the canopies as you move.

vilagitas.title: Mood lighting
vilagitas.desc: Atmospheric ambient lighting, evening after evening.
vilagitas.detail: Carefully designed, warm-toned lighting throughout every room creates a cozy atmosphere indoors and out on the terrace. The lights pulse softly as dusk settles.

kilatas.title: Panoramic view
kilatas.desc: A breathtaking panorama of the surrounding hills.
kilatas.detail: Every major window and the terrace open onto a breathtaking panorama of forested hills — from sunrise to sunset. The layers of the landscape gain depth as you scroll.

klima.title: Climate comfort
klima.desc: Modern split AC in every room.
klima.detail: Modern split air conditioning in every room keeps the temperature just right, so your stay remains comfortable even at the height of summer. A cool current sweeps the space as you move.

tv.title: Smart TV & streaming
tv.desc: Netflix, HBO Max and other streaming services.
tv.detail: Large Smart TVs equipped with Netflix, HBO Max and other streaming services — perfect for a quiet film night in the silence of the forest. The screen's glow fills the evening.

konyha.title: Full kitchen
konyha.detail: A fully equipped modern kitchen with every tool, pot, and appliance you need to cook comfortably on your own. Aromas slowly wander through the house.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Information on the processing of personal data under EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR).

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.body: Ádám Róbert, private individual registered for tax in Hungary, operator of the Vityilló Guest House (Szőlősor dűlő 119, 2896 Szomód, Hungary). Contact: vityillo.szomod@gmail.com, +36 30 455 2876.

sections.heading: 2. Scope of data processed
sections.body:
Contact form: name, email address, phone number (optional), subject and message.
Booking request: name, email address, phone number, arrival and departure dates, number of guests (adults and children by age band), and optionally how you found us and any special requests.
On arrival, at check-in, we record the guest data required by law (e.g. citizenship, date of birth, identity document data) – the website does not ask for these.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose and legal basis
sections.body:
Contact and booking requests: answering your enquiry and taking steps prior to entering into a contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) and (f)).
Guest data recorded at check-in: legal obligations applicable to accommodation services, including NTAK reporting and the VIZA system (GDPR Art. 6(1)(c)).
Loading Google Maps: your consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)).

sections.heading: 4. Data retention
sections.body: Accounting documents are kept for 8 years as required by law; booking data is retained until the purpose ceases. The website does not store form submissions: they are delivered to the operator by email.

sections.heading: 5. Data transfers and processors
sections.body:
Your data is transferred only on the basis of a legal obligation (e.g. NTAK, authorities). It is not shared with third parties for marketing purposes.
The website relies on the following processors:
• Vercel Inc. (USA) – hosting and serving the website; technical request logs (e.g. IP address).
• Supabase Inc. – storing and serving images and videos; your IP address when they are downloaded.
• Resend (USA) – delivering form messages to the operator by email.
Transfers outside the European Economic Area rely on an adequacy decision (EU–US Data Privacy Framework) or standard data protection clauses.

sections.heading: 6. Google Maps
sections.body: The embedded map loads only with your consent. Google (Google Ireland Ltd. or Google LLC) then receives your IP address as an independent controller and may set cookies. You can withdraw consent at any time under "Cookie settings" in the footer.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies and local storage
sections.body:
We use no tracking, analytics or advertising cookies. Your browser's local storage holds only settings the site needs to work, and none of them is sent anywhere:
• vityillo-consent-v1 – your consent choice (until deleted)
• vityillo-theme – light/dark theme (until deleted)
• hasWatchedCinematic – the opening animation has been played (until deleted)
• vityillo-dev-notice-seen, cinematic-prompt-seen, cinematic-force – display state (until the browser tab is closed)

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, rectification or erasure of your data, restriction of processing and data portability, and you may object to processing based on legitimate interests. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal. You may lodge a complaint with the Hungarian National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH, 1055 Budapest, Falk Miksa utca 9–11, naih.hu) or turn to the courts.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Terms governing the use of Vityilló Guest House services.

sections.heading: 1. Subject of the contract
sections.body: The Vityilló Guest House (operator: Ádám Róbert, private individual registered for tax in Hungary; NTAK registration number: MA25108720) provides private accommodation services under these terms.

sections.heading: 2. Booking and confirmation
sections.body: A booking starts with the submission of the form and becomes final upon the Operator's written confirmation. The prices shown are indicative; the final price is stated in the confirmation.

sections.heading: 3. Payment terms
sections.body: A deposit may be required to finalise the booking. The remaining amount is payable on site upon arrival. The tourist tax is payable on site.

sections.heading: 4. Cancellation
sections.body: For cancellations made 14 days before arrival, the deposit is fully refundable. For cancellations within 14 days, the deposit is non-refundable.

sections.heading: 5. House rules
sections.body: Check-in from 3:00 PM, check-out until 10:00 AM. Smoking is prohibited inside the house. The pool and sauna are used at the guests' own risk.

sections.heading: 6. Liability
sections.body: The Operator accepts no liability for guests' valuables or for damage resulting from improper use of the services.
